{
  "name": "otto-hud",
  "displayName": "Otto HUD",
  "version": "0.3.4",
  "description": "Otto, a blue octopus, forecasts your context window on one line above the prompt, in the Claude Code desktop app for now: weather scaled to auto-compact with what fills the context on hover, the tokens each recent prompt added, and your 5-hour and 7-day limits with a pace projection. Labels in English or French. Fork of Anthropic's Token Weather (Apache-2.0).",
  "author": {
    "name": "Manuel"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/manuacl/claude-mods/tree/main/plugins/otto-hud",
  "repository": "https://github.com/manuacl/claude-mods",
  "documentationUrl": "https://github.com/manuacl/claude-mods/blob/main/plugins/otto-hud/README.md",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/manuacl/claude-mods/issues",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://github.com/manuacl/claude-mods/blob/main/plugins/otto-hud/README.md#privacy",
  "license": "Apache-2.0",
  "keywords": [
    "octopus",
    "context",
    "rate-limits",
    "token-weather"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "language": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Language",
      "description": "Labels in English (en) or French (fr). auto, or any other value, follows Claude Code's language setting, and falls back to English.",
      "required": false,
      "default": "auto"
    }
  }
}
